$schema.description: Path or URL of the JSON Schema.

schemaVersion.description: Data file format version. Readers reject versions they do not know.

modelPath.description: glTF model, relative to this file.

anyOf.description: Voltage range of a varying source.

maxCurrentMa.description: power-out only: the most current the rail may supply.

optional.description: The part works with this pin unconnected (no warning when left open).

sources.description: Datasheets and product pages the values come from.

notes.description: Assumptions and estimated values, with reasons.

supplyV.description: Allowed voltage on the power-in pin.

logicLevelV.description: Signal level of the part. "supply" means it follows the power-in voltage.

currentMa.description: Current drawn from the power-in pin, excluding what its power-out pins supply.

label.description: Header label when it differs from the number.

uart0.description: Used by the USB serial bridge.

throttleCurve.description: Piecewise-linear map from command to output, inputs from 0 to 1.

cellEmptyV.description: Cell voltage at which the pack counts as empty.

r1Ohm.description: Top resistor, from IN to OUT.
